purpose: Primary-source packet for replacing the pilot's MCAR-only missingness task with heterogeneous mask-distribution shift and mechanism-aware prediction.
scope_warning: The records below are literature evidence, not endorsements. Abstract excerpts are short verbatim spans; inspect the full paper before making claims.

sources.title: Robust prediction under missingness shifts
sources.mechanism: Training and deployment may have different missingness mechanisms. The paper studies ignorable shifts, where missingness depends only on observed data, versus non-ignorable shifts.
assumptions: The complete-data and label distribution can remain invariant under an ignorable mask shift.
The target missingness mechanism may not be known.
sources.failure_mode: Under non-ignorable shifts, the Bayes predictor can change; exploiting informative missingness can then fail. Source performance is not a reliable selection criterion under deployment shift.
sources.abstract_span: the reasons why a covariate goes missing can change once a model is deployed
sources.role_in_packet: Core challenge definition and mask-shift test design.

sources.title: StableMiss+: Prediction with Incomplete Data Under Agnostic Mask Distribution Shift
sources.mechanism: Preserves correlations among feature values while removing correlations among masks and between features and masks, using weighting under agnostic mask shifts.
assumptions: The complete-feature/label joint distribution is invariant.
The mask distribution can shift without being observed during training.
The weighting assumptions differ depending on whether masks depend on observed feature values.
sources.failure_mode: Removing feature correlations as well as mask correlations can discard predictive structure; preserving them is the proposed correction. The method does not solve arbitrary non-ignorable shifts.
sources.abstract_span: the joint distribution of complete feature and label is invariant, but the mask distribution may shift agnostically
sources.role_in_packet: Chinese primary source and a concrete stable-versus-informative missingness molecule.

sources.title: What's a good imputation to predict with missing values?
sources.mechanism: Jointly learn imputation and regression with a NeuMiss-style network rather than optimizing imputation accuracy first and prediction second.
assumptions: Prediction, rather than unbiased parameter inference, is the target.
The model can represent links across observed and unobserved variables and missingness patterns.
sources.failure_mode: A two-step pipeline can be statistically or computationally mismatched; perfect imputation is not required for asymptotic prediction. Finite-sample performance depends on the architecture and data regime.
sources.abstract_span: we suggest that it is easier to learn imputation and regression jointly
sources.role_in_packet: Baseline for a genuine imputation-prediction molecule; prevents rebranding joint learning as new.

sources.title: Prediction with Missing Data: Target Probabilities and Missingness Mechanisms
sources.mechanism: Separates two predictive targets: whether the missingness indicator is used as signal, and whether it is not. This clarifies when pattern submodels or unconditional imputation can be optimal under non-MAR mechanisms.
assumptions: The deployment target must specify whether the observation indicator is part of the prediction target.
Consistency conditions can be weaker than MAR for some targets.
sources.failure_mode: Choosing the wrong target or treating development, validation, and deployment missingness as identical can produce misleading model selection.
sources.abstract_span: a distinction between two prediction targets, defined according to whether or not the indicator of observation of the predictors is
sources.role_in_packet: Formal label for the target-definition confound in mask-aware prediction.

sources.title: Nearly Optimal Bayesian Inference for Structural Missingness
sources.mechanism: Separate an in-model posterior over missing values from label prediction and integrate posterior uncertainty instead of using one plug-in imputation.
assumptions: Structural missingness can be represented by a structural causal model prior.
Posterior uncertainty is estimable from the observed data and missingness structure.
sources.failure_mode: Single-value imputation can lock in uncertainty and produce overconfident decisions; MNAR values may come from a shifted distribution. Results depend on the SCM prior and benchmark regime.
sources.abstract_span: plug-in imputation, a single fill-in can lock in uncertainty and yield overconfident, biased decisions
sources.role_in_packet: Candidate molecule: mechanism model -> posterior predictive integration -> calibrated decision.

sources.title: Domain Adaptation Under MNAR Missingness
sources.mechanism: Reduces domain adaptation under MNAR missingness shift to an imputation problem, with an extension for simultaneous MNAR and covariate shifts.
assumptions: The MNAR source and target mechanisms satisfy the paper's reduction assumptions.
The available EHR covariates provide enough structure for the imputation step.
sources.failure_mode: Standard covariate-shift importance weighting is not directly applicable under MNAR; simultaneous mask and covariate shift is harder than either alone.
sources.abstract_span: the common covariate shift solutions, including importance weighting, are not directly applicable
sources.role_in_packet: A direct prior-art check for any proposed missingness-shift adaptation.

sources.title: Exploiting the Data Gap: Utilizing Non-ignorable Missingness to Manipulate Model Learning
sources.mechanism: Treat missingness as an adversarially engineered mechanism and formulate its design as bilevel optimization against complete-case, mean-imputation, and regression-imputation learners.
assumptions: The attacker can influence which entries are missing.
The learner uses one of the modeled remediation strategies.
sources.failure_mode: The missingness mechanism is not generally identifiable; attacks can change statistical conclusions with moderate missingness, so mask robustness should include adversarial mechanism tests.
sources.abstract_span: Learning the underlying missingness mechanism from the data is not possible in general
sources.role_in_packet: Adversarial negative case and security-oriented stress test.

sources.title: Discretizing Continuous Time Series for Imputation with Masked Diffusion Training
sources.mechanism: Use an explicit MASK token structurally distinct from valid observations and train masked diffusion to predict original values, with stochastic discretization for continuous time series.
assumptions: Temporal structure and ordinal discretization preserve useful signal.
The masking process used for training is informative for deployment scenarios.
sources.failure_mode: A train-time masking distribution can mismatch real temporal missingness; the method is specific to time series and should not be transferred to tabular data without a mechanism audit.
sources.abstract_span: The MASK token is structurally orthogonal to valid observations
sources.role_in_packet: Masked-self-supervision prior art and a temporal extension of the molecule ledger.

sources.title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
sources.mechanism: Tree boosting learns a default direction for missing values at each split, allowing prediction without a separate imputer.
assumptions: A learned default direction is adequate for the missingness patterns encountered at deployment.
The tree ensemble can preserve useful missingness signal without explicit mask modeling.
sources.failure_mode: A default direction learned under one missingness distribution may be wrong under a changed mask mechanism; tree-native handling is therefore a baseline, not a solution to mechanism shift.
sources.abstract_span: A sparsity-aware split finding algorithm is proposed to handle sparse data
sources.role_in_packet: Tree-native baseline for all tabular experiments.

sources.title: How Far Are We from Predicting Missing Modalities with Foundation Models?
sources.mechanism: Uses an agentic miner/verifier loop to mine cross-modal information, invoke a generator, and refine missing-modality predictions.
assumptions: Observed modalities contain enough information to generate a useful missing modality.
A verifier can identify and refine bad generations.
sources.failure_mode: Missing modality prediction is not ordinary scalar imputation; generated high-level semantics can look plausible while being wrong, and the agentic verifier adds a new judge dependency.
sources.abstract_span: our agentic framework ensures the quality of generated modalities via an autonomous self-refinement mechanism
sources.role_in_packet: Bridge from tabular missingness to agentic molecule generation; use only as a bounded prior-art source.

new_experiment_target.train: Generate complete-data labels, then train under MCAR and MAR masks with fixed seeds.
new_experiment_target.validation: Select hyperparameters on unseen mask rates but known mechanism families.
new_experiment_target.test: Evaluate on a held-out mechanism family: MNAR, block/structural masks, and an agnostic mask mixture. Keep complete features and labels fixed so only the mask mechanism changes.
candidate_molecules: mask mechanism -> posterior predictive integration -> calibrated decision
structural mask token -> temporal or modality predictor
new_experiment_target.kill_rule: Reject a molecule if its gain disappears on a held-out mechanism family, if component removal does not reduce the predicted effect, or if it only wins under MCAR while losing under MAR/MNAR shift.
new_experiment_target.provenance: Every mask generator gets a named mechanism, seed, formula, and hash. No proposal is treated as a new atom until prior-art review, independent held-out transfer, and ablation pass.
